data.narrative: The student completed the capstone deployment and verification module, operationalizing zero-downtime rolling deploys, dependency-aware readiness gating, and sub-15-second automated rollbacks. They demonstrated comprehensive production readiness across all 8 modules, successfully diagnosing and mitigating triple production anomalies spanning shallow readiness blind spots, memory leaks, and out-of-band configuration drift.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed minimal, secure, non-root Alpine container images with strict resource bounds (1GB RAM ceiling, V8 old space caps) and immutable git SHA tags.
dimension_scores.evidence: Docker containers executed under appuser with memory limits and verified clean layer footprints.

dimension_scores.observation: Architected end-to-end CI/CD automation combining fail-fast lint/test gates with zero-downtime rolling deploys and automated rollback scripts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented scripts/deploy.sh and scripts/rollback.sh with verified 12-second rollback execution.

dimension_scores.observation: Exposed Prometheus telemetry across RED metrics (rate, error, duration) and coupled them with heap memory leak alerting rules and live/ready probes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified curl /metrics output and added HighMemoryUsage alerts on nodejs_heap_size_used_bytes.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that deployments are only done when post-deploy verification proves business routes succeed, exposing the hazard of shallow readiness checks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added post-deploy business smoke checks in deploy.sh and articulated 3 AM cognitive degradation safeguards.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced fail-closed stances on writes and fail-open cached read fallbacks, backed by circuit breakers with decorrelated jitter and bounded timeouts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified 503 Service Unavailable with Retry-After headers on write failures and instant fallback on reads.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored comprehensive service operations manuals, copy-pasteable runbooks with positive/negative outputs, and postmortem records.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created docs/service-overview.md and docs/runbooks.md covering top 3 failure modes without ambiguous placeholders.

strengths: End-to-end production discipline: built defense-in-depth across containers, CI/CD, config, observability, and runbooks
Empirical verification over assumption: verified all deployment, degradation, and rollback behaviors against real container drills
Automated self-healing: automated rollback triggering under 15 seconds upon health check or business smoke failure
data.recommendation: Continue practicing chaos engineering game days and automated canary deployments in live distributed environments.

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Eliminates deployment outages and protects end-user experience from flawed releases

Integrated real endpoint payload verification before promoting image to stable
Demonstrated 12-second automated rollback to previous stable tag upon verification failure

Excels with concrete CLI execution feedback, reproducible container metrics, and layer inspection tools.
